goals.title: Cast the island's bells
goals.pitch: Carve a bell into wet sand, pour molten bronze into it, break the mould and hear what you made: every bell rings the note of the shape you carved.
goals.play: One cast is one bet with a loud answer. You carve the bell's profile into a damp sand mould with a stick (a thick lip rings higher, a tall waist lower, a dent you left rings sour), melt the scrap metal the friends bring in the kiln, and pour: the glowing metal runs into the mould by its real flow, too cold a pour leaves a hole, too fast a pour washes the sand. Then you break the sand away, hang the bell and knock it, and its note comes from its own vibration modes, computed from the shape you made, so no two bells sound alike. A bad bell is melted down and cast again, so you learn what each cut does to the sound. Each friend wants a bell that rings its own call, and one by one the bells you cast hang in a frame on the hill until together they play a tune, and the friends ring them at dusk.
goals.moment: Lumi knocks the sand off a still-dark bell, hangs it, strikes it, and a clear deep note rolls over the island; every friend stops and turns towards the hill.
road: first check it is fun: three bell profiles cut by hand into a mould, each one turned into a solid and its note computed with physics/modes.jl (voxels, FEM, modes); a film of the three being knocked, sounding clearly different
the mould in Jump in: Lumi carves the profile into damp sand with a stick, and the bell that comes out keeps every cut
the pour: molten metal flows into the mould and glows as it cools (the glass cooling model); a cold pour leaves holes that make the bell sound dull
the bell frame on the hill: each friend gets a bell that rings its call, and they ring them at dusk
a tuned set: re-cast until the bells play a tune together

goals.title: Wet the hill and dig
goals.pitch: Wet the hill with pond water and dig homes into it for your friends: damp sand holds, dry sand pours.
goals.play: Damp sand stands in steep walls, dry sand pours and soaked sand slides, and you read which is which at a glance: dark, pale or shiny. The sun dries the hill from the surface in, so every wall is on a clock: wet it again, shore it with a stick, or let it go. Sticks bow and creak before they snap; a trickle from the ceiling means the roof is going. A friend moves into a room big enough for it that stands through one night, and if it caves in while they sleep, you dig them out. The hill keeps every tunnel, and over the days it becomes a warren of your making.
goals.moment: A dried-out roof pours down behind Pinchy, and Lumi digs from the other side, pouring pond water so the walls hold, until a claw pokes through and everyone cheers.
road: first check it is fun: a block of hill as granular soil with moisture on the GPU, the mouse digs and pours water; a film of a damp tunnel that stands, the same tunnel drying pale and trickling, and a too-wide roof that caves in
Lumi digs and carries water in Jump in
sticks set by hand carry load, bow, creak and snap
